_why: Large terminal frames can exceed the pipe buffer. Under the wrapper's global pipefail, grep -q exits on an early match, the upstream printf takes SIGPIPE, and each wait gate reads a match as a non-match. Each mutation restores one pipeline independently and is pinned to the regression node for that gate.
_sweep: The 2026-09-01 repo-wide printf/grep-q and head sweep ruled out the remaining sites: the recovered-response predicate re-reads an unchanged completed agy log only after the same extractor returned empty; the pane-slot predicates receive only the newline-separated live-handle list; cmux alive reads the operational surface tree rather than retained terminal content; and the head sites reduce receipt/pin fields or filtered JSON. None accepts the retained 200-320 KB terminal frame that makes these two wait gates unbounded. CORRECTION 2026-09-01: the recovered-response rule-out was FALSIFIED. It argued about re-reading the log, not about the size of the response -- which _cmd_exec passes through whole and unbounded. A controlled probe measured a 240 KB response carrying `VERDICT: COMPLIANT` being blanked while the same text at 18 B was kept. Fixed by extracting `_recovered_has_verdict` to a here-string; see mutation-specs/agy_recovery_sigpipe.json. The remaining rule-outs in this sentence stand. CORRECTION 2026-09-01 (2): the cmux-alive rule-out was ALSO falsified. It argued that the surface tree is not retained terminal content -- a reachability claim that was never measured -- and the deeper error is that this producer is an EXTERNAL process, so the pipe buffer is not the bound at all: a streaming producer is SIGPIPEd at any size (measured at 110 B). Fixed; see mutation-specs/cmux_alive_sigpipe.json. The pane-slot and head rule-outs still stand: those producers are the `printf` builtin over small values.

mutations.name: not-while-large-match-uses-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Restore printf | grep -q only on the negative gate. A large frame carrying the busy marker then fails open because pipefail reports printf's SIGPIPE instead of grep's match.

mutations.name: until-large-match-uses-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Restore printf | grep -q only on the positive gate. A large frame carrying required evidence then fails closed because pipefail reports printf's SIGPIPE instead of grep's match.
